description:
**Blocked by d06.2. Read deck §12 "Extension points: replacing
components" (specifically the "Custom overlays / focus-grabbing
widgets" subsection) and §4 "Component API".**

Modal dialog components. Today rendered via
`render_dialog_overlay/3` in `interactive.ex` — a switch
statement matching on dialog type. Under VDom they become regular
components mounted at the screen root when active; the overlay
switch disappears.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/login_dialog.ex`
  (~110 lines). Username/password entry; uses Input internals
  and emits its own cursor.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/summarize_prompt.ex`
  (~115 lines). Confirmation prompt for `/compact`.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` lines 1058-1075
  — `render_dialog_overlay/3` clauses. Deleted in this ticket
  (or in d06.6 for the Screen-root collapse — coordinate).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/overlay.ex` — overlay
  positioning (centered, sized, padded). Stays put; dialog
  components emit a VBox whose container in Screen wraps it via
  Overlay positioning.
- Tests: find via `find apps/octo_pi_tui/test -name 'login*' -o
  -name 'summarize*'`.

**Target shape (per dialog):**
- Functional component: `def render(props, ctx, h)`.
- Dialog-internal state via `use_state` (login: username,
  password, focused_field; summarize: just selected_button).
- Key handlers via `use_key` for: arrow nav, tab to next field,
  Enter to submit, Escape to cancel.
- Cursor: when the dialog has an editable field, emit a
  `%VCursor{}` after the active text. Last-paint-wins (d06.7)
  gives correct focus behaviour without explicit arbitration —
  the dialog paints AFTER the main flow because it's mounted
  later in the Screen tree, so its cursor wins.
- Dismiss/submit completion routes through the existing
  caller-id pattern in interactive.ex (the dialogs already do
  this; the wrapper changes shape but the contract doesn't).

**Acceptance:**
- Per-dialog tests stay green.
- `render_dialog_overlay/3` clauses for these two dialogs deleted
  from interactive.ex.
- tmux smoke run:
  * Open login dialog (whatever the trigger is — check
    `keybindings.ex`); type a username, tab to password field,
    type, hit Enter; cursor positions correctly throughout.
  * Trigger `/compact`; the summarize prompt appears, arrow keys
    select between buttons, Enter submits, Escape cancels.
  * Both dialogs visually unchanged from main.
- Modules' `defstruct` and `@behaviour Component` (legacy shape)
  deleted.

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. The d06 plan refactored octo_pi_tui in place; the new direction builds octo_pi_tui2 as a parallel implementation on Filament, leaving octo_pi_tui frozen. New epics: opi-58c, opi-pyl, opi-yhj, opi-t3t, opi-ow9, opi-4tr, opi-m6b. Closing without further work.
